Require documented hyperthyroidism/thyrotoxicosis and separately documented atrial fibrillation. The broad cardiac-arrhythmia target is used only for the atrial-fibrillation phenotype supported by PMID 38377675; do not extend this edge to sinus tachycardia, ventricular arrhythmias, other supraventricular rhythms, palpitations, or an abnormal pulse without AF documentation. Preserve temporal thyroid status, restoration of euthyroidism, structural heart disease, age, and other AF risk factors when evaluating individual attribution. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
